title: AI Efficiency: Time Saved or Expectations Raised
discussion_signal: The post connects the field experiment's reduced email and after-hours work with a broader question about who controls time saved by AI. It contrasts measurable time savings with the possibility that employers raise expectations, while explicitly noting that another company's result does not establish a universal pattern.
linked_research_question: Does generative AI return time to workers, or does organizational expectation convert efficiency into expanded scope and intensity of work?
limits: Post combines the NBER experiment with a separate company study
The author frames an open normative question rather than estimating employer responses
LinkedIn discussion is a selected audience
